generation_parents.algorithm: Replace the ratio-of-savings form with an additive regret-style score: for each candidate compute its best insertion cost between the current node and the depot, subtract a capacity-weighted depot-return term, and add a demand-priority term, with a cheap span-normalised scale so the rule stays scale-invariant.
